backend.claims: This backend is a demonstration of the interface. It measures no neurons, runs no connectome and its memory term is simulated. Never present a procedural run as live neural activity.

backend.rule: Momentum divided by realised volatility, compared against a fixed threshold. Stand-in for the real engine.

arms.detail: After each observation the candidate anti-Hebbian rule adapts the 7,835 existing KC→MBON07/11 efficacies from actual spike counts and the engineered reward/aversive pulse. The changed weights feed the next observation.
arms.name: Gordon Flykko
arms.tagline: Every fee is a lesson. Allegedly.

disclaimers: Paper trading only. This project places no real orders and holds no account credentials.
Engineered reinforcement is not pain, pleasure or consciousness. Positive P&L need not be realised profit.
The DNp20 decoder is a fixed engineered interface, not a discovered buy/sell neuron.
Memory updates are not assumed to help. Profitable learning has not been demonstrated upstream or here.
Rivalry commentary is entertainment, not analysis.
Buy & hold faces no order-size, cooldown or daily-order limits; the flies do.

data_manifest.motor_interface: Stonkfly uses DNp20 mean right-minus-left firing with a DNpe017 spike gate for buy/sell/hold. This is an engineered trading interface.
data_manifest.retina_model: R1-R6 luminance-only. Column inferred from all contacts onto annotated L1/L2/L3; modal column. Experimental overlapping viewport projection, not calibrated retinal angles.
data_manifest.training: The compiled graph is the baseline. Runtime adds the documented candidate KC-to-MBON07/11 plasticity and R8-to-aMe12 sign assumption.
data_manifest.visual_dynamics: Photoreceptors and lamina are graded in vivo. This experiment uses an explicit LIF proxy, low-pass luminance drive and tonic lamina current; it is not validated fly vision.
